breadcrumb: Std 9 Social Science (English) — Economics Unit 4: Agriculture in Tamil Nadu — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: According to the 2001 census, 49.3% out of the total population of workers were involved in agriculture. The percentage has reduced to 42.1 in the next 10 years. In 2011 there were three crore 29 lakh workers in Tamilnadu of which 96 lakh were agricultural workers.

en.q: The percentage of workers involved in agriculture in Tamil Nadu changed from 49.3% (2001) to
en.explanation: In 2011 there were 3.29 crore workers in Tamil Nadu, of whom 96 lakh were agricultural workers.

ta.explanation: 2011இல் 3.29 கோடி தொழிலாளர்களில் 96 இலட்சம் பேர் வேளாண் தொழிலாளர்கள்.

questions.quote: In 2011, nearly 55% of the women were involved in agriculture whereas nearly one third (35.3%) of the male population was involved in agriculture during the same year.

en.q: According to the 2011 data in the textbook, the share of women involved in agriculture in Tamil Nadu was nearly
en.explanation: Nearly one third (35.3%) of the male population was involved in agriculture.

ta.q: 2011 தரவின்படி தமிழ்நாட்டில் வேளாண்மையில் ஈடுபட்ட பெண்களின் விழுக்காடு ஏறத்தாழ
ta.explanation: ஆண்களில் ஏறத்தாழ மூன்றில் ஒரு பங்கு (35.3%) வேளாண்மையில் ஈடுபட்டனர்.

questions.quote: During 2015-16, there were 79,38,000 cultivators in Tamil Nadu. But five years earlier there were 81,18,000 cultivators. ... the area under cultivation also reduced from 64.88 lakh hectares to 59.71 lakh hectares

en.q: The number of cultivators in Tamil Nadu in 2015-16 was
en.explanation: Five years earlier there were 81,18,000 cultivators; the cultivated area fell from 64.88 lakh ha to 59.71 lakh ha.

questions.quote: Micro farmers account to around 78% of the total cultivators, while the area cultivated by these micro farmers is just 36%. Small farmers cultivating 1-2 hectares of land cover 14%, while the land cultivated by them is 26%.

en.q: Micro farmers account for about ______ of the cultivators in Tamil Nadu but cultivate only about ______ of the area.
en.explanation: Small farmers are 14% of cultivators and cultivate 26% of the area.

ta.q: குறு விவசாயிகள் தமிழ்நாட்டின் விவசாயிகளில் ஏறத்தாழ ____; ஆனால் பயிரிடும் பரப்பு ____

questions.quote: The number of marginal farmers has increased in India. In contrast, the number of marginal farmers is decreasing in Tamil Nadu. This shows that the farmers are doing other occupations.

en.q: The textbook states that, in contrast to India as a whole, the number of marginal farmers in Tamil Nadu is
options: decreasing, as farmers move to other occupations
en.explanation: The total land area under agriculture is shrinking fast in Tamil Nadu and throughout India.

ta.q: இந்தியாவில் குறுவிவசாயிகள் அதிகரிக்கும்போது தமிழ்நாட்டில் அவர்கள் எண்ணிக்கை
ta.explanation: வேளாண் நிலப்பரப்பு தமிழகத்திலும் இந்தியாவிலும் வேகமாகக் குறைந்து வருகிறது.

questions.quote: Out of this only one third of land is used for agriculture (45,44,000 hectare). 17% of the land is used for non agricultural use. Nearly the same size (2125 thousand hectares) of land are forests. About 4% of the total land is unusable. One tenth of the land is barren. Other fallow lands are 13 percent.

en.q: According to the textbook, how much of Tamil Nadu's total geographical area is used for agriculture?
en.explanation: About 17% is for non-agricultural use, about the same area (21.25 lakh ha) is forest, 4% is unusable, one tenth barren and 13% other fallow lands.

ta.explanation: 17% வேளாண் சாரா பயன்பாடு; ஏறத்தாழ அதே அளவு காடுகள்.

questions.quote: In 2012-13, out of the total cultivated land, nearly 72 percent is used for food crops and the remaining for non-food crops.

en.q: In 2012-13, nearly what percentage of the cultivated land in Tamil Nadu was used for food crops?
en.explanation: The remaining was used for non-food crops.

ta.q: 2012-13இல் தமிழ்நாட்டில் பயிரிடப்பட்ட நிலத்தில் உணவுப் பயிர்களுக்குப் பயன்பட்டது ஏறத்தாழ

questions.quote: There are no perennial rivers in Tamil Nadu. Tamil Nadu receives the required water from the Northeast and Southwest monsoons. ... Northeast monsoon (Oct-Dec) is a major source of water for Tamil Nadu.

en.q: Which statement about water in Tamil Nadu is correct, according to the textbook?
options: Tamil Nadu depends only on the Southwest monsoon
Tamil Nadu has many perennial rivers
There are no perennial rivers; the Northeast monsoon is a major source of water
en.explanation: When the Southwest monsoon is heavy in the Cauvery catchment in Karnataka, the dams fill and the Cauvery in Tamil Nadu gets water.

ta.q: நூலின்படி தமிழ்நாட்டின் நீர் பற்றிய சரியான கூற்று
options: வற்றாத ஆறுகள் இல்லை; வடகிழக்குப் பருவமழை முக்கிய நீராதாரம்
ta.explanation: கர்நாடகத்தில் தென்மேற்குப் பருவமழை மிகுந்தால் காவிரியில் நீர் வரும்.

questions.quote: Conventional water bodies like lakes, ponds and canals provide water for agriculture in Tamil Nadu. 2,239 canals run through Tamil Nadu covering a length of 9,750 km. ... 15 lakh open wells and there are 3,54,000 borewells in the state.

en.q:
Match List I with List II.
List I: a) Canals provide water to  b) Open wells provide water to  c) Borewells irrigate  d) Lakes provide water to
List II: 1) 6.68 lakh hectares  2) 4.93 lakh hectares  3) 3.68 lakh hectares  4) 11.91 lakh hectares
en.explanation: Agriculture in Tamil Nadu is dependent mostly on groundwater.

ta.q:
பட்டியல் I-ஐ பட்டியல் II உடன் பொருத்துக.
பட்டியல் I: அ) கால்வாய்ப் பாசனம்  ஆ) திறந்தவெளிக் கிணற்றுப் பாசனம்  இ) ஆழ்துளைக் கிணற்றுப் பாசனம்  ஈ) ஏரிப்பாசனம்
பட்டியல் II: 1) 6.68 இலட்சம் ஹெக்டேர்  2) 4.93 இலட்சம் ஹெக்டேர்  3) 3.68 இலட்சம் ஹெக்டேர்  4) 11.91 இலட்சம் ஹெக்டேர்
ta.explanation: தமிழ்நாட்டு வேளாண்மை பெரிதும் நிலத்தடி நீரைச் சார்ந்தது.

questions.quote: Agriculture in Tamil Nadu is dependent mostly on groundwater. Use of ground water for agriculture creates many hardships too... as the amount of water taken increases, the ground water goes down resulting in complete dryness or change into unusable water.

en.q: Which is a hardship caused by over-use of groundwater, according to the textbook?
options: Groundwater goes down, resulting in dryness or unusable water
en.explanation: It is very urgent to regulate the usage of underground water for sustainable farming.

ta.q: நூலின்படி நிலத்தடி நீரை அளவுக்கு மீறிப் பயன்படுத்துவதால் ஏற்படும் இடர்
options: நிலத்தடி நீர் மட்டம் குறைந்து முழு வறட்சி அல்லது பயன்படாத நீராக மாறுதல்
ta.explanation: நிலையான வேளாண்மைக்கு நிலத்தடி நீர் பயன்பாட்டை ஒழுங்குபடுத்துவது அவசியம்.

questions.quote: The term 'virtual water' was introduced by Tony Allen in 1990. The water consumed in the production process of an agricultural or industrial product is called 'virtual water'. ... it takes 1340 cubic metres of water to produce one metric ton of wheat.

en.q: According to the textbook, the term 'virtual water' was introduced by Tony Allen in
en.explanation: Virtual water is the hidden flow of water when food or other commodities are traded; producing one metric ton of wheat takes about 1,340 cubic metres of water.

ta.q: 'மெய்நிகர் நீர்' (Virtual water) என்ற சொல்லை டோனி ஆலன் அறிமுகப்படுத்திய ஆண்டு (பாடநூலின்படி)
ta.explanation: ஒரு டன் கோதுமை உற்பத்திக்கு ஏறத்தாழ 1,340 கன மீட்டர் நீர் தேவை.

questions.quote: India is the largest global freshwater user. India has been the fifth largest exporter of virtual water in the world.

en.q: According to the textbook, India has been the ______ largest exporter of virtual water in the world.
en.explanation: India is described as the largest global freshwater user.

ta.q: நூலின்படி உலகில் மெய்நிகர் நீரை ஏற்றுமதி செய்வதில் இந்தியாவின் இடம்

questions.quote: Micro irrigation technology is a very good remedial measure to tackle shortage in irrigational water. ... only required amount of water is supplied at regular intervals... reduction of labour expenses and weed growth... fertilizer is distributed through water

en.q: Which of the following is an advantage of micro irrigation?
options: Only the required amount of water is supplied, reducing labour expenses and weed growth
en.explanation: It increases the ability of water use and productivity of the crop.

options: தேவையான நீர் மட்டும் வழங்கப்படுவதால் களை, ஆள்கூலி குறைவு
ta.explanation: நீர் வழியாக உரமும் வழங்கப்படுவதால் மகசூல் அதிகரிக்கும்.

questions.quote: Different water sources for irrigation - Irrigated area: Wells - 62%, Canals - 24%, Lakes - 14%

en.q: Which source irrigates the largest share of the irrigated area in Tamil Nadu according to the chart?

questions.quote: River Cauvery is the 3rd largest river in South India. Its length is 765 km. The dams constructed across Cauvery in Tamil Nadu are Mettur Dam, Kallanai.

en.q: Which of the following dams are constructed across the Cauvery in Tamil Nadu, according to the textbook?
en.explanation: The Cauvery is described as the 3rd largest river in South India.

ta.q: நூலின்படி தமிழ்நாட்டில் காவிரியின் குறுக்கே கட்டப்பட்டுள்ள அணைகள்
ta.explanation: காவிரி தென்னிந்தியாவின் மூன்றாவது பெரிய ஆறாகக் குறிப்பிடப்படுகிறது.

questions.quote: Productivity of paddy in 1965-66 was 1,409 kg. ... The production was 4,429 kg in the year 2014-15. In the past fifty years, the productivity of paddy has increased more than three times. The food grain production capacity has increased about 3.5 times between 1965-66 and 2014-15.

en.q: Between 1965-66 and 2014-15, the productivity of paddy in Tamil Nadu increased
en.explanation: Paddy productivity rose from 1,409 kg (1965-66) to 4,429 kg per hectare (2014-15).

ta.q: 1965-66 முதல் 2014-15 வரை தமிழ்நாட்டில் நெல்லின் உற்பத்தித் திறன்
